purpose: Provenance for the S02-A numerical convergence study. Every number in reports/s02_convergence.csv must be reproducible from this manifest.
units: atomic units (Hartree, bohr) throughout; Octopus default output level

octopus.binary_note: built in S00, not rebuilt in S01/S02; no source modification exists

fork.note: byte-identical to baseline; S02-A is a measurement of the unmodified code

pseudopotentials.used_in: NOT used in S02-A; recorded because it fixes the Ar+ electron count for S03/S04
pseudopotentials.verified_consequence: z_valence=8.00 => neutral Ar has 8 valence e-; Ar+ therefore has 7 valence e-. This confirms the PHYSICS_TASK_RU statement against the actual file rather than assuming it.

runtime_env.LC_ALL: C (forced in tests/s02_convergence.sh; ru_RU locale writes decimal commas and corrupts CSV)
runtime_env.note: without OCTOPUS_SHARE the binary aborts: 'Cannot open variables file' (recorded in S00)

not_claimed: No physical validation. This measures discretisation error of a single C atom.
No Ar+, no CNT, no TDDFT, no ETF, no moving ion.
No MPI, no GPU, no HPC.
